author: zachey4
body:
I was banned for no reason, I did nothing wrong. Until I was tempbanned by a abusive mod name: Jahaj He is very abusive. he never warned me either. He just banned me without proof, or evidence I did anything wrong. Please unban me since I was happily playing the game until he abused tempbanned me. SO please unban my abused ban
Thank you :)
P.S He banned a guy for spawn blocking? He didn't even warn the person, such abuse :) So please unban me so I can play avic once more, and actually have fun :)

title: Banned By A Abusive Mod

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
You were being somewhat rude to other players, and you did receive multiple warnings and your ban is legitimate. However 3 days is unreasonable, and therefore I have shortened your ban to 1 day instead. Also, refrain from calling staff abusive please, we are simply performing our job and I believe Jahaj's judgement on your ban wasn't abusive.

Regards,
Arigenn, Senior Moderator.
